“Who needs armor when you've got so much junk?”

**Junk Shield** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases Damage Resistance and Energy Resistance based on Luck and amount of junk held. The perk bonus can be expressed by the equation below:

The bonus from junk starts at 1 item and provides 5 resistance. The max bonus can be achieved with 100 items and is equal to 75; additional junk items do not increase the effect further. The resistances gained from junk items are further multiplied by the luck multiplier which is based on current luck value:

| ![FO76 junk shield perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/e/e8/FO76_junk_shield_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Luck | Resistance Multiplier | 
| | 1 | 1 | 
| | 15 | 1.5 | 
| | 30 | 1.8 | 
| | 60 | 1.9 | 
| | 100 | 2 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain Resistances based on your LCK and amount of junk held. | 003E21E6 | 

- The perk is affected by junk *quantity* , not by junk*weight* .
 - The optimal junk to carry is cork scrap or loose screws, as they are the lightest junk items in the game at 0.03 weight.
 - Legendary modules or Vault steel are good options as they are light and are not dropped when a character dies.
- Before update 56 junk shield had 3 ranks that provided 10/20/30 DR and ER. The perk did not work while in Power armor. 1 junk held increased resistances by 1/2/3, each additional 5 junk held increased the resistances further by 1/2/3.
